remarks: Beautiful Townhouse in the Sought-After Forest Mews Complex located just minutes from the heart of downtown Stamford, this stunning townhouse offers an open and inviting layout with modern amenities. The first floor boasts a spacious, open-concept design, featuring a wood-burning fireplace and sliding doors that lead to a deck overlooking a charming courtyard. The kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, marble countertops, and custom wood cabinetry, providing ample storage and workspace. Upstairs, the primary suite is a true retreat, complete with vaulted ceilings, two walk-in closets, and sliding doors to a private balcony overlooking the courtyard. The ensuite bathroom features a large vanity, tiled shower stall, and linen closet. The second bedroom is generously sized, and the conveniently located second-floor laundry adds to the home's functionality. Additional features include an attic for extra storage, an assigned garage parking spot, and a floating parking space right in front of the unit. With its prime location, just minutes from downtown Stamford, this townhome offers both convenience and charm.
